Details
  • Paper: MobileNetV4 -- Universal Models for the Mobile Ecosystem, ECCV 2024, 2024-04-16
  • Original code: https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models at 0df212b369a5
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/tensorflow/models/blob/master/official/vision/modeling/backbones/mobilenet.py (TensorFlow): The authors' code is TensorFlow; timm's PyTorch implementation carries its own ImageNet-1k weights (e500_r256_in1k).
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files:
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/timm/mobilenetv4_conv_medium.e500_r256_in1k/blob/ad66898c045c1b5223ea3f2c0830b74cf2e75bac/README.md
  • Training data: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: mobilenetv4_conv_medium.e500_r256_in1k (default of mobilenetv4_conv_medium)
  • Outputs: logits; label_set: imagenet-1k
  • Input size: fixed 256x256: the input is resized (short side 269) and centre-cropped to it
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): mobilenetv4_conv_medium.e500_r256_in1k 256x256 (0.1 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved)
  • mobilenetv4_conv_medium.e500_r256_in1k 224x224, first call: portable + torch.compile 7 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 20 s (ONNX + engine).
  • mobilenetv4_conv_medium.e500_r256_in1k original 224x224: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
  • mobilenetv4_conv_medium.e500_r256_in1k load / first call: original 1.56 s / 2.286 s, portable 0.36 s / 0.035 s, kernels 1.89 s / 0.051 s
  • Protocol, median of 9 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input (synthetic for bench_inputs sizes), card defaults; gc before each load; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls

Measured

fastforks: the model's own resize / crop on the GPU; original: the library's pretrained loader and its PIL eval transform. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.
